pricing.rationale: Pay per click: verifiable without trusting a pixel. Maximise conversions within the budget: bids move between $0.25 and the $2.00 cap (category default) to spend it well; no CPA target is invented.
pricing.tcpa_unlock: tCPA unlocks after conversion tracking is verified and 50 click-through conversions are recorded.
